## Part A - Basic Operations

```{r}
# A1
v <- seq(5,50, by = 5)
length(v)
sum(v)
mean(v)
```
```{r}
# A2
w <- rep(c(1, 2 , 3), 4)
z <- rep(c(1, 2, 3), each = 4)
w
z
```
```{r}
# A3
17 %% 5
17 / 5
2^10
sqrt(144)
pi
```
```{r}
# A4
a <- c(2, 4, 6, 8)
b <- c(1, 3, 5, 7)
a + b
a * b
a > b
sum(a * b)
```
```{r}
# A5
paste("Student 1", "Student 2", "Student 3")
42
42L
"42"
41i
TRUE

typeof(42)
typeof(42L)
typeof("42")
typeof(41i)
typeof(TRUE)
```
## Part B - Data Frames and Conditional Statements

```{r}
# B1
id <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8)
name <- c("Alice", "Bruno", "Chen", "Dana", "Elif", "Farid", "Grace", "Hiro")
sex <- c("F", "M", "M", "F", "F", "M", "F", "M")
section <- c("A", "B", "A", "C", "B", "C", "A", "B")
midterm <- c(78, 85, 92, 67, 74, 88, 95, 59)
final <- c(82, 79, 96, 71, 80, 91, 93, 65)
attendance <- c(95, 88, 100, 72, 90, 85, 98, 60)

students <- data.frame(id, name, sex, section, midterm, final, attendance)
students
```
```{r}
# B2
str(students)
dim(students)
colnames(students)
summary(students)
```
```{r}
# B3
#students <- 
students <- cbind(students, average = (midterm + final) / 2)

```

```{r}
# B4
students$passed <- ifelse(average >= 70 & attendance >= 75, TRUE, FALSE)

students
```

```{r}
# B5
students <- cbind(students, standing = ifelse(average >= 90, "Honors", ifelse(average >= 75, "Good", "Needs Support")))
students
```

```{r}
# B6

```
